# Ezekiel 47 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 47:5 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-he-measured a-thousand — a-torrent which I-could-not pass-through, for the-water had-risen — water-of swimming — a-torrent which could-not be-crossed. |
| LOGOS | Again he measured a thousand, and it was a river that I could not pass through, for the water had risen. It was deep enough to swim in, a river that could not be crossed on foot. |
| PNEUMA | He measured off another 1,750 feet, and it was a river so deep I couldn't cross it on foot. It was deep enough to swim in — a river nobody could wade across. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 47:6 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-he-said to-me, "Have-you-seen, son-of-man?" And-he-led-me and-brought-me-back to the-bank-of the-torrent. |
| LOGOS | And he said to me, "Son of man, have you seen this?" Then he led me back to the bank of the river. |
| PNEUMA | He asked me, "Son of man, do you see all this?" Then he led me back along the riverbank. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 47:8 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-he-said to-me, "These waters go-out to the-eastern region and-go-down to the-Arabah and-enter the-sea — to the-sea the-stagnant-waters — and-the-waters will-be-healed. |
| LOGOS | And he said to me, "This water flows toward the eastern region and goes down into the Arabah, and enters the sea; when the water flows into the sea, the water will become fresh. |
| PNEUMA | He explained, "This river flows east through the desert into the Dead Sea. When it reaches the Dead Sea, the salty water there becomes fresh! |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 47:11 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Its-swamps and-its-marshes will-not be-healed; to-salt they-are-given. |
| LOGOS | But its swamps and marshes will not become fresh; they are to be left for salt. |
| PNEUMA | But the swamps and marshes will not be made fresh. They will be left as a source of salt. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 47:14 (overlap: 6%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-you-will-inherit-it, each like-his-brother, which I-lifted My-hand to-give to-your-fathers; and-this land will-fall to-you as-an-inheritance. |
| LOGOS | And you shall divide equally what I swore to give to your fathers. This land shall fall to you as your inheritance. |
| PNEUMA | Divide the land equally. I swore to give this land to your ancestors, and it will now be your inheritance. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 47:19 (overlap: 7%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-the-south-side — southward: from-Tamar to the-waters-of Meribath-kadesh, [along]-the-brook to the-Great Sea. And-this [is] the-south-side — southward. |
| LOGOS | On the south side, it shall run from Tamar as far as the waters of Meribath-kadesh, from there along the Brook of Egypt to the Great Sea. This shall be the south side. |
| PNEUMA | The southern border runs from Tamar to the waters of Meribah-kadesh, then along the Brook of Egypt to the Mediterranean. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.
